sources.name: godot-simple-sky-project
sources.adaptation: Fixed night gradient and moon sphere intersection; native noise replaces expensive procedural clouds, authored moon replaces calendar/light-index dependency, procedural stars replace unqualified image.

sources.name: Godot-Spatial-Fire-Raymarched
sources.adaptation: Ray/box slab intersection, advected 3D noise and density integration adapted to closed mouth-axis expanding mesh; six samples, no billboard/depth reconstruction/jitter/dynamic 24-step loop. Low quality/Compatibility selects nested spatial shells. Native 32-cubed seamless FastNoiseLite replaces source texture recipe. Inward-only noise-advection tongues and tail taper remain within the original clipped hazard envelope.

retained_architecture.adaptation: Nine decorative textured modules: four planar foundation facades, four distant ruin columns, lower courtyard. Facades rotate into their horizontal span; degenerate or near-zero source thickness is retained, never divided. Existing floor/stairs/perimeter collision unchanged.

compatibility.selection: Native sampler3D, six fixed samples; low quality/GL Compatibility nested-shell branch. No screen/depth or quarter-resolution sky dependency. 32px incremental sky radiance, four updates/second.

runtime_qualification: Pending parent import/boot and independent earned-route, audio, visual and representative performance validation.
